frozen: 2026-10-24, before selecting or downloading any case

nlst_stable.selection: Farina 2025 patients with exactly one Farina nodule row at each of T0/T1/T2 and Cancer=0; NLST prsn cancyr empty; ctab (sct_ab_desc=51) exactly one nodule per study_yr 0/1/2; |long_t - long_0| <= 1 and |perp_t - perp_0| <= 1 mm; exclude the 12 NLST patients already in data/; if > 30 remain, numpy default_rng(20261024).choice(sorted, 30)
nlst_stable.series: the exact Farina series UID per timepoint (soft-kernel recon)
nlst_stable.identity: Farina (i=col, j=row, k=slice ascending along normal) -> NIfTI voxel (j, i, k); best-scoring detector box within 10 mm (as hero eval); no match = detection miss
nlst_stable.measure: A7 (nodule-measure-v1, f=0.5 k=1.5 r=1 mm) and box (w+h)/2 per timepoint, unchanged code
nlst_stable.metrics: per interval (T0->T1, T1->T2): delta = later - earlier mean diameter. False growth = delta > 1.5 mm. Also |delta| median, and |A7 - NLST reported mean| per scan

lidc_pool2.selection: same eligibility as nodule-holdout-v1; exclude the 23 LIDC patients used so far; numpy default_rng(20261025).choice(sorted ids, 20)
lidc_pool2.use: tuning pool for any later stability fix; scored descriptively now with frozen A7 (same metrics as holdout), no gates
